verdict.rationale: Jan's README lists Custom Assistants for creating specialized AI assistants for your tasks. The assistants docs show task-specific persona instructions (e.g., a Python/JavaScript mentor prompt) and let you assign an assistant to a project, so every conversation there uses that persona and its instructions. Missing for 10: documentation of per-assistant settings beyond instructions (e.g., model choice, parameters, tool selection), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
